title: Uellix node/batch test manifest
description: Frozen BEFORE implementation, by the uellix-test-manifest skill. A manifest is a commitment, not a report — it declares what will be proven, not what already passed. Unknown/absent required evidence in a filled manifest must be represented explicitly (e.g. "UNKNOWN") rather than omitted, so a validator can fail closed instead of treating a missing key as satisfied.

manifest_id.description: Stable identifier for this node/batch, e.g. "W3-B1" or "FIBIU-42".

authority_reference.description: Path or identifier of the frozen authority this manifest is scoped under. Required whenever the node touches anything FIB/PC-01B/IM-01B governs.

dependencies.description: Other manifest_ids or authority ids this node's test contract assumes are already CLOSED. Checked via pnpm ops:program-state, never assumed from memory.

protected_surfaces.description: Repo-relative glob patterns this node's diff is expected to touch that fall under ods-scope's DEFAULT_PROTECTED_PATTERNS. Empty array is a valid, explicit "none expected" — never omit the key to mean the same thing.

protected_authority.description: The --protected-authority id (e.g. HPO-ODS-W2-01) this node claims, if any. null when no protected surface is touched.

postgres_requirements.description: Present only if this node needs a real PostgreSQL probe. Always via pnpm db:audit:disposable — never staging/production/the canonical local stack.

setup_manifest.description: Repo-relative path to the disposable-harness setup manifest.

probe_manifest.description: Repo-relative path to the disposable-harness probe manifest.

sentinels.description: Synthetic marker values (fictional secrets, canary strings) this node's tests plant to prove a security/redaction property — e.g. "a generated password never appears in tool output". Never a real credential.

known_conditions.description: condition_ids from docs/ops/ods/KNOWN_TEST_CONDITIONS_v1.0.0.json this node's baseline is expected to still carry. Verified via pnpm ops:test-diff, never re-adjudicated by prose.

positive_controls.description: The happy-path proofs this node's implementation must satisfy.

negative_controls.description: Deliberate proofs that an unauthorized/incorrect input is REFUSED. A manifest with zero negative controls is incomplete by definition — every new deterministic gate needs one (see the shared operating model, section 3).

mutation_controls.description: Proofs that removing a specific safety guarantee (e.g. a finally-block teardown, a fail-closed branch) is CAUGHT by the test suite — i.e. the test would fail if that guarantee were deleted. Not literal mutation-testing tooling; a regression test framed this way is sufficient.

exit_gates.description: The machine gates this node must pass before commit. Each entry names an existing command — never prose describing what a gate "should" do.

test_file.description: Repo-relative path once written. May be "UNKNOWN" while the manifest is still a pre-implementation commitment.
